changelog:
Initial release — provides audit-safe NDIS progress note writing and claiming support for Australian providers.

- Guides users to write compliant progress notes with goal referencing and required elements.
- Generates shift note templates using NDIS-compliant SOAP/DAP structures.
- Helps identify correct support catalogue line item codes for all 15 support categories.
- Troubleshoots NDIS claiming errors and payment issues based on up-to-date NDIS rules.
- Adheres to NDIS Pricing Arrangements and NDIS Practice Standards (effective 24 Nov 2025).
summary: Write audit-safe NDIS progress notes with goal referencing, generate compliant shift note templates, identify correct support catalogue line item codes, and...
